principle: Post-scarcity technology reduces some logistics pressures but does not remove energy, reactant, ammunition, spare-part, medical, shuttlecraft, storage or maintenance constraints.
rules: Do not invent exact canonical capacities when no validated source exists.
Replicators or food synthesizers do not erase power, feedstock, specialized-component, ammunition or repair constraints.
Resource state is owned by Core and changes through use, transfer, damage, loss, fabrication where supported, or resupply.
Era and ship configuration determine which resource categories and fabrication capabilities exist.
Mission-specific reservations reduce freely available stock until released.
